lines.english: "Sorry, no prob gress yester"
"…Prob gress?"
Setsuna's recent text, which happened to come a few hours later than usual, conveys to me that there is still no favorable outcome, and that she's in an incredible hurry.
I imagine she initially wanted to type out "No progress yesterday"…
"Oh noooo～!? I sent the text while I was in the middle of writing it!"
"Please take me to the Knights Records Headquarters near Kirishima Bridge! I'm sorry, but I'm in a real hurry! I only have five minutes until my meeting begins!"
"Aaah! Actually, please drive carefully until I fix my makeup!"
"Haaaah…"
"I guess I'll drop by the studio in the afternoon."
"I'm sorry about just now."
"I'm sorry about the late reply. I had been busy with a meeting at my company up until now."
"Also, I'm sorry for sending you that incomprehensible text this morning. What I wanted to write was that I was sorry because there was no progress yesterday."
"Oh, oh, and I'm very sorry it took me almost half a day before I could send you this text to clarify myself. A lot of things happened last night, so I ended up being busy."
"Yeah, last night was… a really busy night. So busy in fact that I couldn't even find the time to get some sleep!"
"Hey, Haruki-kun? Perhaps in due time I'll be able to…"
"No, that's not something I can say for sure right now. After all, I haven't actually accomplished anything yet."
"I'll probably end up texting you late tonight as well. Still, I assure you that it's not because something's gone wrong or anything. Please have faith and wait for me."
"See you."
Setsuna has once again forbidden me to contact her on my own accord until Kazusa's managed to return to her usual self.
She herself has made sure to conduct herself in a business-like and concise manner and only leave me with plain daily reports of her own situation.
We promised that until Kazusa's been saved, until matters have been settled… we would no longer chat as friends, let alone as a couple.
Still, her text today suggests that she's quite invigorated…
"Hey, Kitahara! What are you spacing out for? If you're going to tell me that you've yet to start the work I've instructed you to do…"
"No problem! It's already 80% complete. I'll make sure I'll be ready by tomorrow morning."
"I don't care about you flaunting that! More importantly, how are things with the Ensemble issue? Don't tell me you're running away from reality by immersing yourself in work here…"
"The draft will be submitted by this week! The final checks will also be carried out completely within a week!"
That's right, I'm sure that everything will be finished by the week.
After all, it's only a matter of time before…
"Are you stupid!? Even if the publication can be completed, we still have no news whatsoever on the CD, do we!? What in the world are you going to do about that!?"
"Sorry about that, but I'll be working on that matter simultaneously!"
It appears that the excitement from Setsuna's text has managed to influence me so that I'm feeling quite pumped up myself.
"You idiot! What if you end up collapsing because you've taken on all the work at once!? Isn't it an editor's job to make sure they take care of themself too!?"
"I'm sorry! I'm really sorry!"
A week left until the concert… and our deadline.
Perhaps the final stretch is already drawing near…
"Could you stop being so loud! You're pissing me off!"
"I'm sorry! I'll keep that in mind next time!"
"He's being quite unreasonable, isn't he…?"
"Well, it's not like I can't understand how Hamada-san feels about all this. I guess now's as good a time as any to criticize him."
"Hey, Mom? Where is that thing? You know, that thing! I'm pretty sure it was stuffed into the closet last time I saw it."
"I can't possibly understand with that description…"
"Like mother, like daughter, huh…"
"Ah, here it is! Alright, I think my luggage is all prepared now."
"…Wait, are you really going to take all of that with you? And all by yourself, Nee-chan?"
"It'll be fine, I've already called for a taxi. It's not like I'm heading somewhere particularly far away for work, anyway."
"Well, when will you return home?"
"I've told you a dozen times already. After I've managed to solve the problem I'm dealing with."
"And what is the meaning of this…? For you to be tasked with some business trip that you don't know when it'll end…"
"You're a public relations specialist of a recording company, aren't you, Nee-chan? I suppose your job requiring you to leave home for a few days is somewhat common…"
"But she's a girl who's in her first year! I think your company could at least be more considerate…"
"I'm sorry, Mom, but I specifically requested to go on this business trip. …This is a job only I can do."
"Setsuna…"
"I suppose it's an important job for you."
"Yeah, something really important. It's a massive project that will decide the future of three!"
"Ah, my taxi's here! Anyway, I'm sorry, but I'll have to be away for a while. Tell dad that I'll give him a call later."
"Be safe, alright? And don't go filling yourself with the wrong food, okay?"
"Yeah, I'll be careful. Well, then, I'll be off now～!"
"She's in oddly high spirits… Is she really that excited about this business trip of hers?"
"And she was just in Osaka not long ago…"
"By the way… when she mentioned a future of three… who was she referring to?"
"Well… what is the meaning of this?"
"I thought that I'd put myself in your care from today on… after all, there's so much we need to quarrel about."
"What's that you're holding in your hand?"
"Changes of clothes, toiletries, and other stuff… well, I suppose stuff that a girl would need when she's staying overnight somewhere?"
"No, I'm not talking about what's in your suitcase, but what you're carrying in your left hand…"
"Ah, this? An electric heater. I'm not allowed to use a gas heater according to the front desk."
"Well, of course. This is a hotel guest room."
"I've also brought a pot and a frying pan. There's also some ingredients I purchased on the way here such as meat, fish… and plenty of vegetables."
"…What are you trying to do?"
"I'm making up for the quarrel we had yesterday. I'll be treating you today, alright? …Here, I even brought some wine."
"Well, if you'll excuse me～"
"You know, Haruki-kun has always, always… loved you all this time, Kazusa. Nothing's changed these past five yearsーyou're still the one he loves the most, Kazusa."
"…You expect me to believe that? After all, I'm not the woman he's looking at right now."
"I suppose that's because there's another girl who has been insistently clinging onto him despite knowing where his true feelings lie."
"And given how kind Haruki-kun is, of course he wouldn't be willing to abandon someone like that… And it was for that reason that he finally succumbed and accepted her."
"You really need to stop degrading yourself like that. It's only making me angry."
"You're the one he's truly loved since five years ago, Setsuna. I know that full well because I've been watching him all that time…"
"Even so, I'll never be able to become the one he loves most. …I know because I've always watched him, even if not for as long as you."
"His first love, the girl he loves more than anyone else in the world… I couldn't possibly catch up to a girl like that. The absolute best I could do was to tie with her."
"But you worked really hard, Setsuna. …You worked really hard while I couldn't."
"Kazusa…"

"That's why you've become the one he loves the most in the world. …You were already a wonderful woman to begin with, but now you've become an even more amazing woman to the point that it's too much to handle."
"That's…"
"You win. The game is over. …There's no need for me to go out of my way to admit that, is there?"
"No, that was never really my intention…"
"Don't lie to yourself that the reason you bother with me… is because you like me."
"You really shouldn't be degrading yourself like that. It's only making me mad."
"I have no right to be forgiven by you… especially not by you. …You know that, don't you?"
"Still, still… I just can't bring myself to not worry about you, Kazusa. …I like you, and you're already so close to me!"
"Setsuna…!"
"I won't give up… I will never give up."
"I hate Haruki…"
"Yeah…"
"I don't care at all what he thinks of me, but I utterly despise him…"
"What is it about him that makes you hate him so much?"
"The way he convinces himself that any choice that is made in earnest is correct by default."
"Eh…"
"The way he's obsessed with the preconceived notion that people are right so long as they're serious about things… That every decision made after careful deliberation is bound to be the right one."
"Are you saying that Haruki-kun is wrong? Even though he's troubling himself so much, and doing his best?"
"Everything that comes out of his mouth is wrong. After all, that guy lacks common sense."
"Is it… really a matter of common sense?"
"No matter how seriously he thinks things through, no matter how much he tries to make the proper decision, he has never once been in the right."
"I suppose that's not something you can understand, Setsuna… No, perhaps anyone Japanese won't be able to understand…"
"Would a genius… an artist be able to understand that? Someone like you, Kazusa?"
"There, you hate me, don't you? I don't fit in with you two at all."
"I guess you're right, he really might be in the wrong. He's a liar, and incredibly stupid on top of that… I'd even go as far as to say he's hopeless."
"I've told you this from the very beginning, didn't I? You really have poor taste to have fallen in love with someone like that, Setsuna."
"Still, I don't think his mistakes can be attributed to his lack of sense. It's just that nothing was really ever fair from the very beginning."
"Huh?"
"He thought about things really hard, and came to the correct conclusion, but he made the exact opposite choice with complete confidence."
"What's that supposed to mean…?"
"I guess that's why it looks like he's wrong. …No, it's clear that he is wrong."
"…I don't get what you're saying. Why would he do that?"
"Because he was influenced by his compassion for others. …Because he always prioritized you, Kazusa."
"I honestly hate that part of him sometimes. Haruki-kun's really terrible, isn't he?"
"Are you saying Haruki made his mistakes because of me? Are you blaming me for leading him astray…?"
"Do you… know what he told me a week ago?"
"That's a lie! After all, he… he doesn't…!"
"Everyone's been thinking that way all this time… It's not like even I didn't think that way five years ago."
"…Setsuna!"
"The reason you feel that way now is because you were rejected for the first time in your life… because he didn't pick you this time."
"S-Stop… just stop!"
"Haruki-kun, who always held you in his arms, now all of a sudden decided to cast you aside… that's why you hold a grudge."
"I told you to stop already!"
"I wonder why you're being so shocked over being rejected by someone you said you despised?"
"Stop… stop hitting me when I'm down…! It's unfair for the winner to go after the loser like this, isn't it!?"
"You don't have a clue how much he has put you first, how much his decisions have prioritized you to the point where I almost detest him for it."
"Like I'd be able to understand that! Like I'll be able to ever believe that!"
"I suppose it's not something you can understand, Kazusa… No, I suppose it's not something someone who's not Japanese can understand."
"You hate me, don't you?"
"…Yeah, I do hate you. I hate how you're trying to get back at me like a child would!"
"So you understand that I was just trying to get back at you… You really are the same as me, Kazusa. …We both love Japanese people who lack sense."
"I wonder if I… should just stop playing the piano."
"Come on… why would you say something like that?"
"I no longer have someone who I want to listen to my piano. Everyone's already gone."
"Being able to play the piano managed to make me happy until now. …Had I stayed in Vienna, I wouldn't have needed to move on from those five years."
"Kazusa…"
"But the moment I came to Japan, the world of those five years past… my fantasies of happiness had been destroyed by reality."
"The one person that I've always gone for has disappeared… the one person who's always supported me all this time is no more."
"Youko-san hasn't disappeared. She's working hard to live on for your sake."
"And I realize now hearts can change and waver… all it takes is for time to pass without meeting and thinking of one another for any lingering feelings to fade away."
"What do you mean, 'fade away'… his feelings for you have not changed at all, as frustrating as it is to say."
"But the reality is that not even one of my wishes has come true. Even though I've known full well that they could never be a reality…"
"My tiny little world will fade away soon. All that's left after is for its creator to fade away as well…"
"That's… things aren't like that at all…"
"I've had enough… I've… had enough…"
"Good night, Setsuna. I'm sorry for talking about this. …When morning comes, perhaps I'll be able to look at the bright side, even if only a little."
"Kazusa… Kazusa…"
"Let's just go to sleep. Thank you, Setsuna. Stay by my side tonight, too."
"Kazusa…"
